```{r}
actionButton("go", "Submit")

Test <- eventReactive(input$go, {
  
  symbols <- c(input$stock1, input$stock2, input$stock3, input$stock4, input$stock5)
  
  Market <-
  getSymbols(symbols,
             src = 'yahoo',
             auto.assign = TRUE,
             warnings = FALSE) %>%
  map(~Ad(get(.))) %>%
  reduce(merge) %>%
  `colnames<-`(symbols)

Market_monthly <- to.monthly(Market,
                             indexAt = "lastof",
                             OHLC = FALSE)
Returns_Market <-
  Return.calculate(Market_monthly,
                   method = "log") %>%
  na.omit()
  
# Risk-free:

getSymbols("DGS3MO" , src = "FRED")

Returns_Risk_Free=DGS3MO[nrow(DGS3MO)]/12/100

# getSymbols(c("DGS3MO","DGS6MO","DGS1", "DGS2", "DGS3", "DGS5",  
#         "DGS7",  
#         "DGS10",  
#         "DGS20",  
#         "DGS30"), src = "FRED")
# 
#   if (input$Risk_Free=="3 Month") {
#     Returns_Risk_Free=DGS3MO[nrow(DGS3MO)]/12/100
#   }
#   else if (input$Risk_Free=="6 Month") {
#     Returns_Risk_Free=DGS6MO[nrow(DGS6MO)]/12/100
#   }
# 
#   else if (input$Risk_Free=="1 Year") {
#     Returns_Risk_Free=DGS1[nrow(DGS1)]/12/100
#   }
# 
#   else if (input$Risk_Free=="2 Year") {
#     Returns_Risk_Free=DGS2[nrow(DGS2)]/12/100
#   }
# 
#   else if (input$Risk_Free=="3 Year") {
#     Returns_Risk_Free=DGS3[nrow(DGS3)]/12/100
#   }
#   else if (input$Risk_Free=="5 Year") {
#     Returns_Risk_Free=DGS5[nrow(DGS5)]/12/100
#   }
#   else if (input$Risk_Free=="7 Year") {
#     Returns_Risk_Free=DGS7[nrow(DGS7)]/12/100
#   }
#   else if (input$Risk_Free=="10 Year") {
#     Returns_Risk_Free=DGS10[nrow(DGS10)]/12/100
#   }
#   else if (input$Risk_Free=="20 Year") {
#     Returns_Risk_Free=DGS20[nrow(DGS20)]/12/100
#   }
#   else {
#     Returns_Risk_Free=DGS30[nrow(DGS30)]/12/100
#   }
#   
#   return(Returns_Risk_Free)

#Optimal Risky:

Returns_DE=Returns_Market

DE_VCOV=cov(Returns_DE)

DE_Mean=matrix(apply(Returns_DE,2,mean))

rownames(DE_Mean)<-symbols

colnames(DE_Mean)<-c("DE_Mean")

DE_Min<-min(DE_Mean)

DE_Max<-max(DE_Mean)

increments=1000

# DE_Target<-seq(DE_Min,DE_Max,
#                length=increments)

DE_Target<-seq(DE_Min,2*DE_Max,
                length=increments)

DE_Target_SD<-rep(0,length=increments)

DE_Weights<-matrix(0,nrow=increments,
                   ncol=length(DE_Mean))

for (i in 1:increments){
  Dmat<-2*DE_VCOV
  
  dvec<-c(rep(0,length(DE_Mean)))
  
  # Amat<-cbind(rep(1,length(DE_Mean)),DE_Mean,
  #             diag(1,nrow=ncol(Returns_DE)))
  Amat<-cbind(rep(1,length(DE_Mean)),DE_Mean)
  
  #bvec<-c(1,DE_Target[i],rep(0,ncol(Returns_DE)))
  
  bvec<-c(1,DE_Target[i])
  
  soln<-solve.QP(Dmat,dvec,Amat,bvec=bvec,meq=2)
  
  DE_Target_SD[i]<-sqrt(soln$value)
  DE_Weights[i,]<-soln$solution}

colnames(DE_Weights)<-symbols

DE_Portfolio<-data.frame(cbind(DE_Target,
                               DE_Target_SD,
                               DE_Weights))

DE_Portfolio=DE_Portfolio%>%
  filter(DE_Target_SD!=0)


DE_Min_Var<-subset(DE_Portfolio,
                    DE_Portfolio$DE_Target_SD
                    ==min(DE_Portfolio$DE_Target_SD))


DE_Portfolio$Sharpe<-(DE_Portfolio$DE_Target-
                        as.vector(Returns_Risk_Free))/
  DE_Portfolio$DE_Target_SD

DE_Tangency<-subset(DE_Portfolio,
                    DE_Portfolio$Sharpe==
                      max(DE_Portfolio$Sharpe))


DE_Complete=rbind(DE_Tangency,
                  c(as.numeric(Returns_Risk_Free)*12,
                    rep(0, ncol(DE_Tangency)-1))
)


Test=cbind(DE_Portfolio, 
           DE_Min_Var$DE_Target, DE_Min_Var$DE_Target_SD, 
           DE_Tangency$DE_Target_SD,DE_Tangency$DE_Target, 
           c(DE_Complete$DE_Target_SD, 
             rep(0, nrow(DE_Portfolio)-2)),
           c(DE_Complete$DE_Target, 
             rep(0, nrow(DE_Portfolio)-2)))

setnames(Test, 
         old = c('c(DE_Complete$DE_Target_SD, rep(0, nrow(DE_Portfolio) - 2))',
                 'c(DE_Complete$DE_Target, rep(0, nrow(DE_Portfolio) - 2))'), 
         new = c('DE_Complete$DE_Target_SD','DE_Complete$DE_Target'))


# Complete Portfolio:
A=input$A

w=subset(DE_Tangency, select=symbols)

E_Rp=sum(colMeans(Returns_DE)*w)

SD=StdDev(Returns_DE, weights = as.numeric(w))

Risk_Weight=as.numeric((E_Rp-Returns_Risk_Free*12)/(A*SD^2))

Riskless_Weight=1-Risk_Weight

Risk_Weight; Riskless_Weight

Complete_Portfolio_Ret=as.numeric(Risk_Weight*sum(colMeans(Returns_DE)*w)+
  Riskless_Weight*Returns_Risk_Free*12)

Complete_Portfolio_SD=sqrt((Risk_Weight^2)*(SD^2))

Complete_Portfolio=data.frame(cbind(Complete_Portfolio_Ret,
                         Complete_Portfolio_SD))

Test=cbind(Test, Complete_Portfolio)

})
```

### Efficient Frontier

```{r}
renderHighchart({
  
highchart() %>%
  hc_add_series(Test(), "line", 
                hcaes(x = DE_Target_SD, 
                      y = DE_Target)
                , name="Efficient Frontier")%>%
  hc_yAxis(title = list(text = "Return"))%>%
  hc_xAxis(title = list(text = "Risk"))%>%
  hc_add_series(Test(), "line", 
                hcaes(x = `DE_Min_Var$DE_Target_SD`, 
                      y = `DE_Min_Var$DE_Target`)
                ,name="Minimum Variance Portfolio", lineWidth=10)%>%
  hc_add_series(Test(), "line", 
                hcaes(x = `DE_Tangency$DE_Target_SD`, 
                      y = `DE_Tangency$DE_Target`)
                ,name="Tangency Portfolio", lineWidth=10)%>%
  hc_add_series(Test(), "line", 
                hcaes(x = `DE_Complete$DE_Target_SD`, 
                      y = `DE_Complete$DE_Target`)
                ,name="Capital Allocation Line", lineWidth=3)%>%
      hc_add_series(Test(), "line", 
                hcaes(x = `V2`, 
                      y = `Complete_Portfolio_Ret`)
                ,name="Complete Portfolio", lineWidth=10)
})
```
